description: Submit a check-in for one of the signed-in user's experiments. `answers` maps the experiment's check-in question ids to the user's answers (get the questions from supstack_experiments_get → protocol.checkIn.questions, or supstack_experiment_protocol). On the FINAL check-in the verdict is computed and returned. A 409 `experiment_incomplete` means this experiment cannot take a check-in yet and nothing was saved: relay its `message` word for word. The check-in number is derived server-side. Every question with category "safety" must be answered (the server returns 400 listing any that are missing): ask the user each one, and if they are not sure, send "not-sure" (valid for yes/no, choice and multi safety questions). Never answer a safety question for the user. When the result carries `safetyAction`, relay its `instruction` to the user FIRST, word for word, before anything else. If `safetyAction.pauses` is true the experiment is paused: do not suggest the next dose or the next check-in, and do not tell the user to stop prescribed medicines. When the result carries `safety`, relay each of `safety.risks` after the instruction. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiment_check_in
